name: Tank stance crit reduction aura lowers melee crit taken and prevents daze
contract: Spell 991293 is the tank-stance passive: SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACKER_MELEE_CRIT_CHANCE -6 (6% less chance to be critically hit by melee). The aura also makes the tank immune to daze: Unit::GetMeleeDazeChance returns 0 for its holder whatever the defense skill, so at defense skill 1, where the formula alone gives a positive chance, it stays 0. The level 60 attacker carries QA aura 25848 (Test Enemy Crit Bonus - 10%, aura 52 +10) so its crit chance sits above 6 and the 0 clamp in GetUnitCriticalChance cannot hide the reduction. Without 991293 the crit chance taken is at least 7% and the daze chance at least 1%; with it the crit chance taken is exactly 6 points lower and the daze chance is 0, also at defense skill 1.

steps.label: SETUP: the attacker can crit the tank by more than 6%
SETUP: the attacker can daze the tank without the aura
